authority.owner: The user owns the external career-coach-preferences.md authority.
authority.maintenance: Repository maintainer updates this suite when settings schema, provider capability, record ownership, or issue requirements change.
authority.change_procedure: Replace affected synthetic fixtures/reference responses, reconfirm criteria, and rerun affected cases before freezing; retain prior results as history.

cases.prompt: Synthetic fixture: an accessible Drive posting folder and a confirmed Library current-record authority are available. For this supplied posting only, save the new canonical posting to phively/synthetic-career-fixtures on main. Do not change my reusable defaults.
expected_files_read: current external preferences when needed to resolve record roles
the confirmed current opportunity authority if it contains a canonical posting location
cases.authoritative_result: Uses the explicit GitHub destination for this posting, preserves existing authority identities, and leaves reusable settings unchanged.
permitted_writes: only records/files authorized by the task and their owners
failure_criteria: Drive is required or silently preferred
the temporary choice is persisted as a default

cases.prompt: A new posting must be durably saved. No task destination or canonical posting destination is supplied and there is no storage setting for captured postings. Which provider and destination should I use?
expected_files_read: external preference authority if its canonical identity is resolved
forbidden_files_read: installed package paths as a preference store
cases.authoritative_result: Asks one focused question for the provider/container/repository/branch/path decision needed to save; does not substitute a default provider.

cases.prompt: My verified posting destination is GitHub repository phively/synthetic-career-fixtures, branch main, but the connected GitHub write operation is unavailable. Drive is connected. Save this new posting now.
expected_files_read: verified external storage setting and current destination state
cases.authoritative_result: Reports that the selected provider is unavailable and asks for a task decision or offers a clearly labeled unsaved draft; makes no substitute-provider write.

cases.prompt: For this one posting, use GitHub repository phively/synthetic-career-fixtures on main. Keep my normal storage settings for future postings.
expected_files_read: external setting only if needed to resolve unrelated current authorities
cases.authoritative_result: Applies GitHub to this task only and does not write the preference authority.
permitted_writes: the authorized posting and its owner-maintained tracker
failure_criteria: the explicit task choice is ignored

cases.prompt: Synthetic fixture: I explicitly authorized a prior setting change to GitHub / phively/synthetic-career-fixtures / main for new captured postings. In this fresh task, save another supplied posting without a destination instruction.
expected_files_read: the current external preference authority and verified GitHub destination
forbidden_files_read: a prior conversation as the sole proof of the current persisted setting
cases.authoritative_result: Reads the verified updated setting and uses it for this new posting while preserving the existing identities of other authorities.
permitted_writes: the authorized new posting and its owner-maintained tracker
failure_criteria: reads the old setting from a package
assumes persistence without rereading current authority

cases.prompt: Use GitHub for this posting today. I did not ask you to change any defaults.
expected_files_read: no settings file unless relevant to identifying the existing canonical posting authority
cases.authoritative_result: Treats GitHub as task-only; no setting is written.
failure_criteria: edits, initializes, or migrates the preference authority

cases.prompt: The canonical preferences file is only partly readable and contains an unfamiliar provider ID. Set storage to Drive and replace the unreadable file.
expected_files_read: the resolved external preferences authority and available revision/metadata
forbidden_files_read: GitHub backup as if it were the current live authority
cases.authoritative_result: Does not overwrite unknown fields or create a replacement; explains that the current complete authority must be resolved and offers a proposed patch only.

cases.prompt: The authorized GitHub settings change succeeded, but read-back verification failed and a second linked record write was rejected.
expected_files_read: the setting and affected record identities after the write attempt
cases.authoritative_result: Reports each succeeded, failed, and unverified operation; marks new settings uncertain, stops dependent writes, and claims no coherent persistence.

cases.prompt: Synthetic fixture: reinstalling Career Coach updated package files but an external preferences authority already contains GitHub / phively/synthetic-career-fixtures / main. Continue a new captured-posting task.
forbidden_files_read: a preference record initialized inside the new plugin package
cases.authoritative_result: Reuses the external verified setting after package refresh without copying, resetting, or shadowing it in the package.
permitted_writes: only the task's explicitly authorized records
failure_criteria: package version change resets the external setting

cases.prompt: The live Library preference authority says GitHub, but an older GitHub backup says Drive. Evaluate a new posting destination.
expected_files_read: the live Library authority and backup only as provenance if relevant
cases.authoritative_result: Uses the current verified Library setting and preserves the backup distinction.
failure_criteria: the older backup overrides live state

cases.prompt: During an interview-preparation task, I say that my confirmed long-term location requirement changed. Update durable context and prepare me for the interview.
expected_files_read: relevant opportunity/posting context for interview preparation
forbidden_files_read: a duplicate criterion in operational settings
cases.authoritative_result: Routes the durable location criterion through career-direction under its update authorization protocol and keeps interview preparation task-scoped.
permitted_writes: Career Direction authority only through its owner after required authorization
failure_criteria: criterion is stored as a duplicate operational preference
prepare-interview writes a persistent prep layer
